2607.10878.title: LOGOS: A Living Logic for AI Agent Teams That Evolve With Humans
2607.10878.paper_summary: AI agents are evolving from answer engines into persistent teams that use tools, delegate work, learn from experience, and modify the artifacts that shape their future behavior. The defining question for deployment is no longer merely what agents can do, but who controls what they are allowed to become. We introduce logos, a pluggable layer for self-evolution and governance that strengthens existing multiagent frameworks rather than replacing them. logos compiles heterogeneous multimodal inputs, including documents, images, audio, tables, databases, APIs, and human instructions into versioned agent packs containing agents, tools, knowledge, tests, permissions, and policies. During operation, it transforms agent activity into portable, auditable event traces and applies fail-closed verification across frameworks and backends. Every learned prompt, memory, skill, tool, role, or workflow remains an untrusted release candidate until held-out execution evidence, human-controlled policy, and explicit authorization permit its promotion. This architecture enables "verifiable human-agent loop engineering": agents can act, ask, learn, and propose improvements, while humans can steer objectives, permissions, approvals, and irreversible actions without interrupting continuous operation. logos provides a living logic for accountable automation. Agents may evolve at machine speed, but only evidence and human authority can close the loop.
2607.10878.paper_summary_zh: AI 代理正在從回答引擎演變為持久的團隊，這些團隊使用工具、委派工作、從經驗中學習並修改塑造其未來行為的人工製品。 部署的決定性問題不再僅僅是代理可以做什麼，而是誰控制他們被允許成為什麼。我們介紹了 logos，一個可插拔的自我演變和治理層，強化現有的多代理框架，而不是取而代之。 logos 編譯異質的多模態輸入，包括文檔、圖像、音頻、表格、數據庫、API 和人類指令，形成包含代理、工具、知識、測試、許可和政策的版本化代理包。在運行過程中，它將代理活動轉換為可攜帶的、可審計的事件痕跡，並在框架和後端之間應用失敗關閉驗證。每個學習的提示、記憶、技能、工具、角色或工作流程在未經保留的執行證據、人為控制的政策和明確授權允許其升級之前，仍然是一個不受信任的發布候選者。這種架構使得“可驗證的人類-代理循環工程”成為可能：代理可以行動、詢問、學習和提出改進，而人類可以在不打斷持續運行的情況下引導目標、許可、批准和不可逆轉的行動。 logos 提供了一種負責任自動化的活邏輯。代理可以以機器速度進化，但只有證據和人類權威才能關閉這個循環。
